text:
Situation: Cefotetan has been on FDA's shortage list since 2014-08-14 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 146 months. Corvale East holds 9.5 days of CEFOTETAN DISODIUM 1G0ML 10ML SDV and 13.4 days of CEFOTETAN 1G0ML 10ML SDV. Corvale Lakeside holds 22 days of Cefotetan 1 g/10mL 10 mL vial and 26.9 days of CEFOTETAN DISODIUM 1 g/10mL 10 mL vial. Corvale General holds 12.4 days and 10.6 days respectively.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected ACS DOBFAR SPA (FEI 3006028606) in Italy on 2016-01-19, 523 days after the shortage was first posted, and classified it OAI with 14 observations on laboratory controls and documentation. A Warning Letter followed on 2017-01-13. Subsequent inspections in 2017, 2018, 2022, and 2024 returned VAI classifications. An alternate manufacturer, PAI Holdings, LLC dba PAI Pharma (NDC 00121097610), is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Our position: The Fresenius Kabi product (NDC 63323038510) manufactured at ACS DOBFAR SPA remains on the FDA shortage list. PAI Pharma product is available and not listed. Internal stock is uneven; Corvale East is below two weeks on the disodium presentation.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 11 vials of Cefotetan 1 g/10 mL, 10 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Purchase cefotetan from PAI Holdings, LLC dba PAI Pharma (NDC 00121097610) — needs buyer approval.
3. Substitute CEFOTETAN DISODIUM 1 g/10mL from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (alternate NDC) — needs pharmacist approval; approved by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-04-28.
4. Substitute Cefotetan 1 g/10mL from PAI Holdings, LLC dba PAI Pharma (alternate NDC) — needs pharmacist approval; approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2026-04-11.

Not recommended: Purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. because its label names no plant we could place.
